paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
heading: Numei Pasal Kipolhna Kikhamte
english: Yahweh said to Moses,

paite: "Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah, 'Kei TOUPA, na Pathian uh ka hi.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘I am Yahweh your God.

paite: Na omna masa uh Aigupta gam mite hih bang in hih kei unla, ka hon pilutna ding Kanaan gam mite dan thusehte bang in leng hih kei un.
english: You shall not do as they do in the land of Egypt, where you lived: and you shall not do as they do in the land of Canaan, where I am bringing you; neither shall you walk in their statutes.

paite: Ka vaihawmte na zui ding ua, ka dan thusehte zui in na mang ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi.
english: You shall do my ordinances, and you shall keep my statutes, and walk in them: I am Yahweh your God.

paite: Huaiziak in ka dan leh ka vaihawmte na mang ding uh ahi, huai mi'n ahihleh ahing ding hi. Kei TOUPA ka hi,' achi hi.
english: You shall therefore keep my statutes and my ordinances; which if a man does, he shall live in them: I am Yahweh.

paite: "Kuamah in na tanau nai numei, avuaktanna lem ding in na zuan ding ahi kei. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
english: “‘None of you shall approach anyone who are his close relatives, to uncover their nakedness: I am Yahweh.

paite: Na pa vuaktanna ahihkeileh na nu vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei. Na nu ahi a, avuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei hi.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father, nor the nakedness of your mother: she is your mother. You shall not uncover her nakedness.

paite: Na pa zi vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei, na pa vuaktanna ahi.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife: it is your father’s nakedness.

paite: Na sanggamnu, na pa tanu hiam na nu tanu hiam, na pianpih hiam, na pianpih louh hiam vuaktanna leng na lem ding ahi kei.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your sister, the daughter of your father, or the daughter of your mother, whether born at home, or born abroad.

paite: Na tapa tanu hiam, na tanu, tanu hiam vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei. Avuaktanna uh nang vuaktanna ahi ngal a.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your son’s daughter, or of your daughter’s daughter, even their nakedness: for theirs is your own nakedness.

paite: Na pa zi tanu, na pa suan vuaktanna, na sanggamnu ahi, avuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife’s daughter, conceived by your father, since she is your sister.

paite: Na pa sanggamnu vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei. Na pa tanaunu nai ahi.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s sister: she is your father’s near kinswoman.

paite: Na nu sanggamnu vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei, na nu tanaunu nai ahi ngal a.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister: for she is your mother’s near kinswoman.

paite: Na pa sanggam vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei, azi na zuan ding ahi kei, amah na nu ahi.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s brother, you shall not approach his wife: she is your aunt.

paite: Na mounu vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei. Na tapa zi ahi a, avuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter-in-law: she is your son’s wife. You shall not uncover her nakedness.

paite: Na sanggampa zi vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei. Na sanggampa vuaktanna ahi.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother’s wife: it is your brother’s nakedness.

paite: Nutate vuaktanna na lem ding uh ahi kei. Avuaktanna lem ding in atapa tanu hiam, atanu tanu hiam na la ding ahi kei. Na tanau naite ahi ua; gitlouhna lianpi ahi.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter. You shall not take her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness; they are near kinswomen: it is wickedness.

paite: Na zi adam lai teng, asanggamnu vuaktanna lem ding in na zi in na nei ding ahi kei hi.
english: “‘You shall not take a wife to her sister, to be a rival, to uncover her nakedness, while her sister is yet alive.

paite: "Numei anitdan ngeina a, anit sung in avuaktanna lem ding in na zuan ding ahi kei.
english: “‘You shall not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is impure by her uncleanness.

paite: Alak a kihihnin ding in na invengpa zi na kithuahpih ding ahi kei.
english: “‘You shall not lie carnally with your neighbor’s wife, and defile yourself with her.

paite: Molek a dia mei a lutsuaksak ding in na gil a gah himhim na pe ding ahi kei, na Pathian min na hihse ding ahi sam kei. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
english: “‘You shall not give any of your children to sacrifice to Molech; neither shall you profane the name of your God: I am Yahweh.

paite: Numei bang in pasal na kithuahpih ding ahi kei. Thilkihhuai ahi.
english: “‘You shall not lie with a man, as with a woman. That is detestable.

paite: Kihihnin ding in ganta himhim na kithuahpih ding ahi kei. Luppih ding in ganta ma ah numei adin ding ahi kei. Gitlouhna tungtuan ahi.
english: “‘You shall not lie with any animal to defile yourself with it; neither shall any woman give herself to an animal, to lie down with it: it is a perversion.

paite: "Hiaite ah, abangmah ah kihihnin kei un. Hiai thil tengteng ah na ma ua ka delhkhiak khitsa namte ana nin khinta uhi.
english: “‘Don’t defile yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations which I am casting out before you were defiled.

paite: Agam leng anin khinta hi. Huaiziak in athulimlouhnate uh ziak in amau ka gawt a, gam in asung a teng mite alokhe khin vek hi.
english: The land was defiled: therefore I punished its iniquity, and the land vomited out her inhabitants.

paite: Huaiziak in nou zaw ka dante, ka vaihawmte na zui ding uh ahi. Hiai thilkihhuaite na hih ding uh ahi kei; na gam ua mi himhim hiam, gamdangmi na lak ua tengte hiam in leng.
english: You therefore shall keep my statutes and my ordinances, and shall not do any of these abominations; neither the native-born, nor the stranger who lives as a foreigner among you;

paite: Hiai thilkihhuai tengteng na ma ua hiai gam a omte'n ana hih khin ua, gam mah leng anin khinta hi;
english: (for all these abominations have the men of the land done, that were before you, and the land became defiled);

paite: na ma ua om nam aluakkhiak mah bang a na hihnit ua, gam in ahon luakkhiaklouhna ding in.
english: that the land not vomit you out also, when you defile it, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.

paite: Kuapeuh hiai thilkihhuaite lak a khatpeuh hihmi achipihte a pan satkhiak ahi ding.
english: “‘For whoever shall do any of these abominations, even the souls that do them shall be cut off from among their people.

paite: "Huaiziak in hiai thilkihhuai na ma ua omte'n achin bang uh na chin samlouhna ding un leh huai a na kihihnitlouhna ding un ka thuseh na zui ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi," achi hi.
english: Therefore you shall keep my requirements, that you do not practice any of these abominable customs, which were practiced before you, and that you do not defile yourselves with them: I am Yahweh your God.’”
